## Purpose

`generated-schema-register.csv` is the current variable-level evidence table
for the internal dataset explainers. It records the actual schema and sampled
value domains/distributions produced by the current `fplida` generators.

This file should be treated as implementation evidence, not official
real-world calibration evidence. Official codebooks, data dictionaries, and
methodology sources still determine what a variable means in source data.

## Register fields

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `guide` | Internal guide family. |
| `dataset` | Dataset or source group. |
| `table` | Generated table/product sampled. |
| `variable` | Generated column name. |
| `type` | R class observed after reading generated output. |
| `n_rows` | Number of sampled generated rows in the table. |
| `missing`, `missing_pct` | Missingness in the sampled generated output. |
| `distinct` | Number of distinct non-missing values in the sampled output. |
| `domain_or_distribution` | For categorical fields, top observed values and counts; for numeric fields, min / p25 / median / p75 / max; for dates, min to max. |
| `values_if_small_domain` | Full observed value list when the sampled domain is small enough to display. |
| `metadata_match` | Whether the variable matched local PLIDA metadata by `dataset + variable`. |
| `plida_variable_descriptions`, `plida_products` | Local PLIDA metadata descriptions/products where a direct match was found. |
| `blade_item`, `blade_valid_response`, `blade_available_periods` | Local BLADE metadata fields where a BLADE variable-name match was found. |

## Current coverage

The register currently contains 1,585 generated variable rows:

| Guide | Datasets | Generated variable rows |
|---|---|---:|
| Home Affairs | `AMEP`, `SDB`, `VISA`, `TRAVELLERS`, `MT_DEMOGS` | 58 |
| DHDA/Health | `MBS`, `PBS`, `AIR`, `MCD`, `NACDC` | 88 |
| DSS | `DOMINO`, `DEX` | 144 |
| Education | `HE`, `AEDC` | 81 |
| VET/Apprenticeship | `TVA`, `A&T` | 88 |
| NDIS | `NDIS` | 11 |
| Vital events | `BIRTHS`, `DEATHS` | 51 |
| Core/Combined | `CORE`, `COMBINED` | 32 |
| BLADE | Selected BLADE tables 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 17, 27 | 825 |
| Census | 2021 person/family/dwelling generated tables | 57 |
| PIT | `PIT_PS`, `PIT_ITR`, and `PIT_IE` FY2021 generated tables | 58 |
| STP | Representative standard/extended pay-event, jobs, and ETP tables | 92 |

PIT coverage now comes from a targeted non-empty FY2021 run under
`/tmp/fplida-pit-schema/fplida_12k`: `PIT_PS` has 5,990 generated rows,
`PIT_ITR` has 5,223 filer rows in each of the four ITR sub-tables, and
`PIT_IE` has 6,055 rows.

## Crosswalk and full metadata inventory

Two companion CSVs separate current generated output from the much larger
local DIL/BLADE metadata surface:

| File | Rows | Purpose |
|---|---:|---|
| [`generated-variable-crosswalk.csv`](generated-variable-crosswalk.csv) | 1,585 | One row per generated variable with direct PLIDA/BLADE metadata matches, manual same-dataset crosswalks, compact/derived metadata-backed fields, and unresolved/not-source-equivalent generated fields. |
| [`local-metadata-variable-inventory.csv`](local-metadata-variable-inventory.csv) | 49,987 | Full local PLIDA/BLADE metadata inventory for the dataset families covered by these guides, including products/tables not emitted by the current generators. |
| [`variable-evidence-appendices/index.qmd`](variable-evidence-appendices/index.qmd) | 12 appendices | Per-guide rendered schema tables with one row per generated variable, observed generated value/domain evidence, local metadata or crosswalk status, and unresolved-source caveats. |

Crosswalk status counts:

| Status | Rows | Interpretation |
|---|---:|---|
| `direct_blade_variable_metadata` | 825 | Generated BLADE variable matched `inst/blade_metadata/variables.csv`. |
| `direct_plida_dataset_variable` | 692 | Generated variable matched local PLIDA metadata by `dataset + variable`. |
| `manual_same_dataset_plida_concept_match` | 58 | Manual same-dataset concept crosswalk from compact/generated name to local PLIDA metadata variable. |
| `generated_compact_from_same_dataset_metadata` | 4 | Generated field compacts multiple same-dataset source-style metadata columns into one generated column. |
| `generated_derived_from_same_dataset_metadata` | 2 | Generated field is derived from a same-dataset metadata variable, usually a date component. |
| `external_source_concept_not_source_equivalent` | 3 | An official/public source concept exists, but the generated field is a local simplification and is not source-equivalent. |
| `local_generator_not_source_equivalent` | 1 | A related same-dataset metadata variable exists, but the generated field is deliberately not source-equivalent. |

## Source hierarchy

Use the following hierarchy when revising the dataset explainers:

1. Official source data dictionary, methodology, or codebook.
2. Local PLIDA/BLADE metadata files under `inst/plida_metadata/` and
   `inst/blade_metadata/`.
3. Current generator output in `generated-schema-register.csv`.
4. Generator code/tests/foundation assumptions.
5. If none of the above exists, state that the source was not found.

Do not present sampled generated values as official source-data distributions.

## Revision rule

Every dataset explainer should now include either:

1. a compact table of key variables plus a link to
   `generated-schema-register.csv`; or
2. a full appendix table derived from `generated-schema-register.csv` for that
   guide.

The guide prose should not assert category domains, distributions, weights, or
coverage unless those values are explicitly present in the register, in local
metadata, or in an official source.
